51	public struct DockHostIdentityResolver: Equatable, Sendable {
52	    private struct HostRecord: Equatable, Sendable {
53	        var host: DockHostConfiguration
54	        var aliases: Set<String>
55	        var displayNames: [String]
56	        var endpoints: [String]
57	        var hasObservedLogicalIdentity: Bool
58	    }
59	
60	    private struct LogicalRecord: Equatable, Sendable {
61	        var logicalHostID: String
62	        var records: [HostRecord]
63	        var hasObservedLogicalIdentity: Bool
64	    }
65	
66	    public static let empty = DockHostIdentityResolver(hosts: [])
67	
68	    private let logicalRecordsByID: [String: LogicalRecord]
69	    private let logicalIDsByAlias: [String: Set<String>]
70	    private let logicalIDByConfiguredHostID: [String: String]
71	    private let hostStatuses: [String: DockHostLoadStatus]
72	
73	    public init(
74	        hosts: [DockHostConfiguration],
75	        observations: [DockHostIdentityObservation] = [],
76	        hostStatuses: [String: DockHostLoadStatus] = [:]
77	    ) {
78	        let observationsByConfiguredHostID = Dictionary(grouping: observations, by: \.configuredHostID)
79	        self.hostStatuses = hostStatuses
80	
81	        var logicalRecordsByID: [String: LogicalRecord] = [:]
82	        var logicalIDByConfiguredHostID: [String: String] = [:]
83	
84	        for host in hosts {
85	            let hostObservations = observationsByConfiguredHostID[host.id] ?? []
86	            let observedLogicalHostID = Self.firstNonEmpty(
87	                hostObservations.map(\.logicalHostID) + hostObservations.map(\.streamHostID)
88	            )
89	            let logicalHostID = observedLogicalHostID ?? host.id
90	            logicalIDByConfiguredHostID[host.id] = logicalHostID
91	
92	            var aliases = Set<String>()
93	            [
94	                host.id,
95	                host.displayName,
96	                host.endpoint.displayEndpoint,
97	                logicalHostID
98	            ].forEach { Self.insertAlias($0, into: &aliases) }
99	            for observation in hostObservations {
100	                [
101	                    observation.configuredHostID,
102	                    observation.streamHostID,
103	                    observation.logicalHostID,
104	                    observation.displayName,
105	                    observation.endpoint
106	                ].forEach { Self.insertAlias($0, into: &aliases) }
107	            }
108	
109	            let displayNames = Self.uniqueNonEmpty(
110	                hostObservations.map(\.displayName) + [host.displayName, logicalHostID]
111	            )
112	            let endpoints = Self.uniqueNonEmpty(
113	                hostObservations.map(\.endpoint) + [host.endpoint.displayEndpoint]
114	            )
115	            let record = HostRecord(
116	                host: host,
117	                aliases: aliases,
118	                displayNames: displayNames,
119	                endpoints: endpoints,
120	                hasObservedLogicalIdentity: observedLogicalHostID != nil
121	            )
122	
123	            var logicalRecord = logicalRecordsByID[logicalHostID]
124	                ?? LogicalRecord(
125	                    logicalHostID: logicalHostID,
126	                    records: [],
127	                    hasObservedLogicalIdentity: false
128	                )
129	            logicalRecord.records.append(record)
130	            logicalRecord.hasObservedLogicalIdentity = logicalRecord.hasObservedLogicalIdentity || record.hasObservedLogicalIdentity
131	            logicalRecordsByID[logicalHostID] = logicalRecord
132	        }
133	
134	        var logicalIDsByAlias: [String: Set<String>] = [:]
135	        for logicalRecord in logicalRecordsByID.values {
136	            for record in logicalRecord.records {
137	                for alias in record.aliases {
138	                    logicalIDsByAlias[alias, default: []].insert(logicalRecord.logicalHostID)
139	                    logicalIDsByAlias[Self.normalizedAlias(alias), default: []].insert(logicalRecord.logicalHostID)
140	                }
141	            }
142	        }
143	
144	        self.logicalRecordsByID = logicalRecordsByID
145	        self.logicalIDByConfiguredHostID = logicalIDByConfiguredHostID
146	        self.logicalIDsByAlias = logicalIDsByAlias
147	    }
148	
149	    public func logicalHostID(
150	        forAlias alias: String,
151	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
152	    ) -> String? {
153	        let aliasLogicalIDs = logicalIDs(forAlias: alias)
154	        if let sourceConfiguredHostID,
155	           let sourceLogicalID = logicalIDByConfiguredHostID[sourceConfiguredHostID],
156	           aliasLogicalIDs.isEmpty || aliasLogicalIDs.contains(sourceLogicalID) {
157	            return sourceLogicalID
158	        }
159	        guard aliasLogicalIDs.count == 1 else {
160	            return nil
161	        }
162	        return aliasLogicalIDs.first
163	    }
164	
165	    public func migrationLogicalHostID(
166	        forAlias alias: String,
167	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
168	    ) -> String? {
169	        guard let logicalHostID = logicalHostID(
170	            forAlias: alias,
171	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
172	        ),
173	              let logicalRecord = logicalRecordsByID[logicalHostID],
174	              logicalRecord.hasObservedLogicalIdentity else {
175	            return nil
176	        }
177	        return logicalHostID
178	    }
179	
180	    public func resolve(
181	        rowHostID: String,
182	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil,
183	        preferredConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
184	    ) -> ResolvedDockHost? {
185	        let logicalHostID = logicalHostID(
186	            forAlias: rowHostID,
187	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
188	        )
189	        guard let logicalHostID,
190	              let logicalRecord = logicalRecordsByID[logicalHostID] else {
191	            return nil
192	        }
193	
194	        guard let selectedRecord = preferredRecord(
195	            in: logicalRecord,
196	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID,
197	            preferredConfiguredHostID: preferredConfiguredHostID
198	        ) else {
199	            return nil
200	        }
201	
202	        return ResolvedDockHost(
203	            logicalHostID: logicalHostID,
204	            host: selectedRecord.host,
205	            configuredHostIDs: logicalRecord.records.map(\.host.id),
206	            displayName: selectedRecord.displayNames.first ?? selectedRecord.host.displayName,
207	            endpoint: selectedRecord.endpoints.first ?? selectedRecord.host.endpoint.displayEndpoint
208	        )
209	    }
210	
211	    public func contains(
212	        rowHostID: String,
213	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil,
214	        in configuredHostID: String
215	    ) -> Bool {
216	        guard let expectedLogicalID = logicalIDByConfiguredHostID[configuredHostID] else {
217	            return false
218	        }
219	        let rowLogicalIDs = logicalIDs(forAlias: rowHostID)
220	        guard rowLogicalIDs.count == 1,
221	              rowLogicalIDs.contains(expectedLogicalID) else {
222	            return false
223	        }
224	        guard let sourceConfiguredHostID else {
225	            return true
226	        }
227	        let sourceLogicalIDs = logicalIDs(forAlias: sourceConfiguredHostID)
228	        if sourceLogicalIDs.isEmpty,
229	           sourceConfiguredHostID == configuredHostID {
230	            return true
231	        }
232	        return sourceLogicalIDs.count == 1 && sourceLogicalIDs.contains(expectedLogicalID)
233	    }
234	
235	    public func displayName(
236	        forAlias alias: String,
237	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
238	    ) -> String? {
239	        resolve(
240	            rowHostID: alias,
241	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
242	        )?.displayName
243	    }
244	
245	    public func endpoint(
246	        forAlias alias: String,
247	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil
248	    ) -> String? {
249	        resolve(
250	            rowHostID: alias,
251	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
252	        )?.endpoint
253	    }
254	
255	    public func state(
256	        forAlias alias: String,
257	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String? = nil,
258	        in states: [DockHostStateViewModel]
259	    ) -> DockHostStateViewModel? {
260	        guard let resolved = resolve(
261	            rowHostID: alias,
262	            sourceConfiguredHostID: sourceConfiguredHostID
263	        ) else {
264	            return nil
265	        }
266	        return states.first { resolved.configuredHostIDs.contains($0.host.id) }
267	    }
268	
269	    private func logicalIDs(forAlias alias: String) -> Set<String> {
270	        let trimmed = alias.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
271	        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else {
272	            return []
273	        }
274	        return logicalIDsByAlias[trimmed]
275	            ?? logicalIDsByAlias[Self.normalizedAlias(trimmed)]
276	            ?? []
277	    }
278	
279	    private func preferredRecord(
280	        in logicalRecord: LogicalRecord,
281	        sourceConfiguredHostID: String?,
282	        preferredConfiguredHostID: String?
283	    ) -> HostRecord? {
284	        if let sourceConfiguredHostID,
285	           let record = logicalRecord.records.first(where: { $0.host.id == sourceConfiguredHostID }) {
286	            return record
287	        }
288	        if let preferredConfiguredHostID,
289	           let record = logicalRecord.records.first(where: { $0.host.id == preferredConfiguredHostID }) {
290	            return record
291	        }
292	        if let loadedRecord = logicalRecord.records.first(where: { isLoadedStatus(hostStatuses[$0.host.id]) }) {
293	            return loadedRecord
294	        }
295	        return logicalRecord.records.first
296	    }
297	
298	    private func isLoadedStatus(_ status: DockHostLoadStatus?) -> Bool {
299	        guard let status else {
300	            return false
301	        }
302	        switch status {
303	        case .loaded, .degraded, .empty:
304	            return true
305	        case .checking, .offline, .error:
306	            return false
307	        }
308	    }
309	
310	    private static func insertAlias(_ value: String?, into aliases: inout Set<String>) {
311	        guard let value = nonEmpty(value) else {
312	            return
313	        }
314	        aliases.insert(value)
315	    }
316	
317	    private static func uniqueNonEmpty(_ values: [String?]) -> [String] {
318	        var seen: Set<String> = []
319	        var result: [String] = []
320	        for value in values {
321	            guard let value = nonEmpty(value),
322	                  seen.insert(value).inserted else {
323	                continue
324	            }
325	            result.append(value)
326	        }
327	        return result
328	    }
329	
330	    private static func firstNonEmpty(_ values: [String?]) -> String? {
331	        values.lazy.compactMap(nonEmpty).first
332	    }
333	
334	    private static func nonEmpty(_ value: String?) -> String? {
335	        let trimmed = value?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
336	        guard let trimmed, !trimmed.isEmpty else {
337	            return nil
338	        }
339	        return trimmed
340	    }
341	
342	    private static func normalizedAlias(_ value: String) -> String {
343	        value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
344	    }
345	}

3	enum ProjectionUpdateKind: String, Equatable, Sendable {
4	    case snapshot
5	    case page
6	    case upsert

12	struct ProjectionWindow: Equatable, Sendable {
13	    let offset: Int
14	    let limit: Int

18	    init(offset: Int, limit: Int, rowCount: Int, nextOffset: Int?) {

26	struct ProjectionEnvelope<Row: Equatable & Sendable>: Equatable, Sendable {
27	    let kind: ProjectionUpdateKind
28	    let schemaVersion: Int
29	    let identityVersion: Int
30	    let projectionEngineVersion: Int
31	    let sourceHostID: String
32	    let view: String
33	    let threadID: String?

38	    let seq: Int64

45	    let reason: String?
46	    let activeTurnID: String?
47	    let liveState: String?
48	    let freshnessStatus: String?

50	
51	    init(
52	        kind: ProjectionUpdateKind,
53	        schemaVersion: Int,
54	        identityVersion: Int,
55	        projectionEngineVersion: Int,
56	        sourceHostID: String,
57	        view: String,
58	        threadID: String? = nil,
59	        scope: String?,
60	        viewParamsKey: String?,
61	        order: String?,
62	        epoch: String,
63	        seq: Int64,
64	        generation: Int,
65	        rows: [Row],
66	        projectionIDs: [String],
67	        complete: Bool?,
68	        totalRows: Int?,
69	        window: ProjectionWindow?,
70	        reason: String?,
71	        activeTurnID: String? = nil,

74	        freshnessError: String? = nil
75	    ) {

77	        self.schemaVersion = schemaVersion
78	        self.identityVersion = identityVersion
79	        self.projectionEngineVersion = projectionEngineVersion
80	        self.sourceHostID = sourceHostID
81	        self.view = view
82	        self.threadID = threadID
83	        self.scope = scope
84	        self.viewParamsKey = viewParamsKey
85	        self.order = order
86	        self.epoch = epoch
87	        self.seq = seq

89	        self.rows = rows

91	        self.complete = complete

102	struct ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row: Equatable & Sendable>: Sendable {
103	    let expectedSchemaVersion: Int
104	    let expectedIdentityVersion: Int
105	    let expectedProjectionEngineVersion: Int
106	    let expectedView: String
107	    let expectedScope: String?
108	    let expectedOrder: String
109	    let requiredThreadID: String?
110	    let isStoredRow: @Sendable (Row) -> Bool
111	    let rowSchemaVersion: @Sendable (Row) -> Int
112	    let rowIdentityVersion: @Sendable (Row) -> Int
113	    let rowProjectionEngineVersion: @Sendable (Row) -> Int
114	    let projectionID: @Sendable (Row) -> String
115	    let sourceHostID: @Sendable (Row) -> String
116	    let view: @Sendable (Row) -> String
117	    let threadID: @Sendable (Row) -> String?
118	    let sourceKey: @Sendable (Row) -> String
119	    let displayOrderKey: @Sendable (Row) -> String
120	    let revision: @Sendable (Row) -> Int?
121	    let hasSameImmutableIdentity: @Sendable (Row, Row) -> Bool
122	}
123	
124	enum ProjectionReducerError: Error, Equatable, LocalizedError, Sendable {
125	    case schemaMismatch
126	    case streamContract(String)
127	    case epochMismatch(expected: String, actual: String)
128	    case sequenceGap(expected: Int64, actual: Int64)
129	    case resyncRequired(String)
130	
131	    var errorDescription: String? {
132	        switch self {
133	        case .schemaMismatch:
134	            return "Projection schema version is unsupported."
135	        case .streamContract(let message):
136	            return message
137	        case .epochMismatch(let expected, let actual):
138	            return "Projection epoch changed from \(expected) to \(actual)."
139	        case .sequenceGap(let expected, let actual):
140	            return "Projection sequence gap: expected \(expected), got \(actual)."
141	        case .resyncRequired(let reason):
142	            return reason
143	        }
144	    }
145	}
146	
147	struct ProjectionReducer<Row: Equatable & Sendable>: Equatable, Sendable {
148	    private(set) var epoch: String?
149	    private(set) var seq: Int64 = 0
150	    private(set) var generation: Int = 0
151	    private(set) var sourceHostID: String?
152	    private(set) var viewParamsKey: String?
153	    private var rowsByProjectionID: [String: Row] = [:]
154	    private var projectionIDsBySourceKey: [String: String] = [:]
155	
156	    init() {}
157	
158	    var rowCount: Int {
159	        rowsByProjectionID.count
160	    }
161	
162	    var rows: [Row] {
163	        Array(rowsByProjectionID.values)
164	    }
165	
166	    mutating func reset() {
167	        epoch = nil
168	        seq = 0
169	        generation = 0
170	        sourceHostID = nil
171	        viewParamsKey = nil
172	        rowsByProjectionID = [:]
173	        projectionIDsBySourceKey = [:]
174	    }
175	
176	    mutating func apply(
177	        _ envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>,
178	        policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>
179	    ) throws {
180	        try validateBaseEnvelope(envelope, policy: policy)
181	        try validateRows(envelope.rows, envelope: envelope, policy: policy)
182	        try validateDeleteIDs(envelope.projectionIDs)
183	
184	        switch envelope.kind {
185	        case .snapshot:
186	            try applySnapshot(envelope, policy: policy)
187	        case .page:
188	            try applyPage(envelope, policy: policy)
189	        case .upsert:
190	            try applyLiveMutation(envelope, policy: policy)
191	        case .delete:
192	            try applyLiveMutation(envelope, policy: policy)
193	        case .heartbeat:
194	            try applyHeartbeat(envelope)
195	        case .resyncRequired:
196	            throw ProjectionReducerError.resyncRequired(envelope.reason ?? "Projection resync required.")
197	        }
198	    }
199	
200	    func sortedRows(policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>) -> [Row] {
201	        rows.sorted { lhs, rhs in
202	            let leftOrder = policy.displayOrderKey(lhs)
203	            let rightOrder = policy.displayOrderKey(rhs)
204	            if leftOrder != rightOrder {
205	                return leftOrder < rightOrder
206	            }
207	            return policy.projectionID(lhs) < policy.projectionID(rhs)
208	        }
209	    }
210	
211	    private mutating func applySnapshot(
212	        _ envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>,
213	        policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>
214	    ) throws {
215	        guard envelope.window != nil, envelope.totalRows != nil, envelope.complete != nil else {
216	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection snapshot is missing its window contract.")
217	        }
218	        let storedRows = envelope.rows.filter(policy.isStoredRow)
219	        rowsByProjectionID = Dictionary(
220	            uniqueKeysWithValues: storedRows.map { row in
221	                (policy.projectionID(row), row)
222	            }
223	        )
224	        projectionIDsBySourceKey = Dictionary(
225	            uniqueKeysWithValues: storedRows.map { row in
226	                (policy.sourceKey(row), policy.projectionID(row))
227	            }
228	        )
229	        epoch = envelope.epoch
230	        seq = envelope.seq
231	        generation = envelope.generation
232	        sourceHostID = envelope.sourceHostID
233	        viewParamsKey = envelope.viewParamsKey
234	    }
235	
236	    private mutating func applyPage(
237	        _ envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>,
238	        policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>
239	    ) throws {
240	        try validateOpenStream(envelope)
241	        guard envelope.seq == seq else {
242	            throw ProjectionReducerError.sequenceGap(expected: seq, actual: envelope.seq)
243	        }
244	        guard let window = envelope.window,
245	              let totalRows = envelope.totalRows,
246	              envelope.complete != nil,
247	              window.offset >= 0,
248	              window.limit >= 0,
249	              window.rowCount == envelope.rows.count,
250	              totalRows >= window.rowCount else {
251	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection page is missing its catch-up window contract.")
252	        }
253	        try upsertRows(envelope.rows.filter(policy.isStoredRow), policy: policy)
254	    }
255	
256	    private mutating func applyLiveMutation(
257	        _ envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>,
258	        policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>
259	    ) throws {
260	        try validateOpenStream(envelope)
261	        if envelope.complete == false || (envelope.window?.offset ?? 0) > 0 {
262	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection catch-up windows must use page updates, not live mutations.")
263	        }
264	        guard envelope.seq == seq + 1 else {
265	            throw ProjectionReducerError.sequenceGap(expected: seq + 1, actual: envelope.seq)
266	        }
267	        for projectionID in envelope.projectionIDs {
268	            remove(projectionID: projectionID, policy: policy)
269	        }
270	        if envelope.kind == .upsert {
271	            try upsertRows(envelope.rows.filter(policy.isStoredRow), policy: policy)
272	        }
273	        seq = envelope.seq
274	    }
275	
276	    private func applyHeartbeat(_ envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>) throws {
277	        try validateOpenStream(envelope)
278	        guard envelope.seq == seq else {
279	            throw ProjectionReducerError.sequenceGap(expected: seq, actual: envelope.seq)
280	        }
281	        guard envelope.rows.isEmpty, envelope.projectionIDs.isEmpty else {
282	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection heartbeat must not mutate rows.")
283	        }
284	    }

286	    private func validateBaseEnvelope(
287	        _ envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>,
288	        policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>
289	    ) throws {
290	        guard envelope.schemaVersion == policy.expectedSchemaVersion else {
291	            throw ProjectionReducerError.schemaMismatch
292	        }
293	        guard envelope.identityVersion == policy.expectedIdentityVersion,
294	              envelope.projectionEngineVersion == policy.expectedProjectionEngineVersion,
295	              !envelope.sourceHostID.isEmpty,
296	              envelope.view == policy.expectedView,
297	              envelope.order == policy.expectedOrder,
298	              let viewParamsKey = envelope.viewParamsKey,
299	              !viewParamsKey.isEmpty,
300	              !envelope.epoch.isEmpty,
301	              envelope.generation > 0 else {
302	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection envelope does not match the expected stream contract.")
303	        }
304	        if let expectedScope = policy.expectedScope,
305	           envelope.scope != expectedScope {
306	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection envelope scope does not match the expected stream contract.")
307	        }
308	        if let requiredThreadID = policy.requiredThreadID,
309	           envelope.threadID != requiredThreadID {
310	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract(
311	                "Projection envelope threadID \(envelope.threadID ?? "<missing>") does not match expected \(requiredThreadID)."
312	            )
313	        }
314	    }

316	    private func validateOpenStream(_ envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>) throws {
317	        guard let epoch else {
318	            throw ProjectionReducerError.epochMismatch(expected: "none", actual: envelope.epoch)
319	        }
320	        guard envelope.epoch == epoch else {
321	            throw ProjectionReducerError.epochMismatch(expected: epoch, actual: envelope.epoch)
322	        }
323	        guard envelope.sourceHostID == sourceHostID,
324	              envelope.viewParamsKey == viewParamsKey,
325	              envelope.generation == generation else {
326	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection update does not match the active view generation.")
327	        }
328	    }
329	
330	    private func validateRows(
331	        _ rows: [Row],
332	        envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>,
333	        policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>
334	    ) throws {
335	        var seenProjectionIDs = Set<String>()
336	        var seenSourceKeys = Set<String>()
337	        for row in rows {
338	            let projectionID = policy.projectionID(row)
339	            let sourceKey = policy.sourceKey(row)
340	            guard policy.rowSchemaVersion(row) == policy.expectedSchemaVersion,
341	                  policy.rowIdentityVersion(row) == policy.expectedIdentityVersion,
342	                  policy.rowProjectionEngineVersion(row) == policy.expectedProjectionEngineVersion,
343	                  policy.sourceHostID(row) == envelope.sourceHostID,
344	                  policy.view(row) == envelope.view,
345	                  policy.threadID(row) == policy.requiredThreadID,
346	                  !projectionID.isEmpty,
347	                  !sourceKey.isEmpty,
348	                  !policy.displayOrderKey(row).isEmpty else {
349	                throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection row does not match its envelope.")
350	            }
351	            guard seenProjectionIDs.insert(projectionID).inserted else {
352	                throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection payload contains duplicate projectionID \(projectionID).")
353	            }
354	            guard seenSourceKeys.insert(sourceKey).inserted else {
355	                throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection payload contains duplicate source identity \(sourceKey).")
356	            }
357	        }
358	    }
359	
360	    private func validateDeleteIDs(_ projectionIDs: [String]) throws {
361	        for projectionID in projectionIDs where projectionID.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty {
362	            throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection delete ID is empty.")
363	        }
364	    }
365	
366	    private mutating func upsertRows(
367	        _ rows: [Row],
368	        policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>
369	    ) throws {
370	        for row in rows {
371	            let projectionID = policy.projectionID(row)
372	            let sourceKey = policy.sourceKey(row)
373	            if let existingProjectionID = projectionIDsBySourceKey[sourceKey],
374	               existingProjectionID != projectionID {
375	                throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract(
376	                    "Projection upsert reused source identity \(sourceKey) under \(projectionID); existing projectionID is \(existingProjectionID)."
377	                )
378	            }
379	            if let existing = rowsByProjectionID[projectionID] {
380	                guard policy.hasSameImmutableIdentity(existing, row) else {
381	                    throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection upsert changed immutable identity for \(projectionID).")
382	                }
383	                if let existingRevision = policy.revision(existing),
384	                   let nextRevision = policy.revision(row) {
385	                    guard nextRevision >= existingRevision else {
386	                        throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection upsert carried stale revision \(nextRevision) for \(projectionID).")
387	                    }
388	                    guard nextRevision > existingRevision || row == existing else {
389	                        throw ProjectionReducerError.streamContract("Projection upsert changed row content without increasing revision for \(projectionID).")
390	                    }
391	                }
392	            }
393	            rowsByProjectionID[projectionID] = row
394	            projectionIDsBySourceKey[sourceKey] = projectionID
395	        }
396	    }
397	
398	    private mutating func remove(
399	        projectionID: String,
400	        policy: ProjectionReducerPolicy<Row>
401	    ) {
402	        if let existing = rowsByProjectionID.removeValue(forKey: projectionID) {
403	            projectionIDsBySourceKey.removeValue(forKey: policy.sourceKey(existing))
404	        }
405	    }
406	}

6	    override func setUp() {
7	        continueAfterFailure = false

9	
10	    func testSamplesRelayBackedDockDisplayOverTime() throws {
11	        let config = try DisplayedUISyncConfig.load()
12	        let app = launchRelayBackedApp(hosts: config.hosts)
13	
14	        let startIdentifier = app.displayedUIWaitForFirstIdentifier([
15	            AutomationID.Dock.root.rawValue,
16	            AutomationID.Bootstrap.manualHostField.rawValue,
17	        ], timeout: 30)
18	        XCTAssertEqual(
19	            startIdentifier,
20	            AutomationID.Dock.root.rawValue,
21	            "Displayed sync proof must start on the relay-backed Dock UI, not the bootstrap form.\n\nAccessibility tree:\n\(app.debugDescription)"
22	        )
23	
24	        let root = app.displayedUIElement(id: AutomationID.Dock.root.rawValue)
25	        XCTAssertTrue(
26	            root.waitForDisplayedUIStringValue(matching: { value in
27	                value.contains("loaded") && !value.contains("Partial")
28	            }, timeout: 30),
29	            "Dock did not reach complete loaded state before sampling. Root value: \(root.displayedUIStringValue)"
30	        )
31	
32	        try DisplayedUIArtifactWriter.resetSamples(at: config.outputPath)
33	        var sampleCount = 0
34	        var observedLoadedDock = false
35	        var sampleIndex = 0
36	        func captureSample(
37	            index: Int,
38	            includeDockSweep: Bool = false,
39	            includeDetailSweep: Bool = false
40	        ) -> DisplayedUISample {
41	            app.captureDisplayedUISample(
42	                index: index,
43	                includeDockSweep: includeDockSweep,
44	                includeDetailSweep: includeDetailSweep,
45	                includeDetailRequestElements: false,
46	                configuredHostIDs: config.resolvedHostIDs
47	            )
48	        }
49	        func record(_ sample: DisplayedUISample) throws {
50	            sampleCount += 1
51	            observedLoadedDock = observedLoadedDock || sample.dockRootValue.contains("loaded")
52	            try DisplayedUIArtifactWriter.appendSample(sample, to: config.outputPath)
53	        }
54	
55	        if let openThreadID = config.openThreadID {
56	            let firstSampleStartedAt = Date()
57	            try record(captureSample(index: sampleIndex))
58	            sampleIndex += 1
59	            waitUntilNextSample(startedAt: firstSampleStartedAt, sampleMS: config.sampleMS)
60	            try record(captureSample(index: sampleIndex))
61	            sampleIndex += 1
62	
63	            guard let row = app.visibleDockRow(hostID: config.openHostID, threadID: openThreadID, timeout: 15) else {
64	                XCTFail("Displayed sync proof could not find target Dock row host=\(config.openHostID ?? "*") thread=\(openThreadID).\n\nAccessibility tree:\n\(app.debugDescription)")
65	                return
66	            }
67	            row.coordinate(withNormalizedOffset: CGVector(dx: 0.5, dy: 0.5)).tap()
68	            XCTAssertNotNil(
69	                app.displayedUIWaitForElement(identifierPrefix: AutomationID.Session.root(threadID: openThreadID).rawValue, timeout: 15),
70	                "Displayed sync proof did not reach target thread detail for \(openThreadID)."
71	            )
72	            if let detailFilter = config.detailFilter {
73	                XCTAssertTrue(
74	                    app.selectMessageFilter(detailFilter, timeout: 10),
75	                    "Displayed sync proof could not switch the real detail filter to \(detailFilter)."
76	                )
77	            }
78	            _ = app.scrollDetailMessagesIntoEvidencePosition(timeout: 5)
79	            let detailReadySampleStartedAt = Date()
80	            let detailReadySample = captureSample(index: sampleIndex)
81	            XCTAssertNotNil(
82	                detailReadySample.detail,
83	                "Displayed sync proof must capture a real Thread Detail sample before allowing the controlled fixture to emit detail mutations."
84	            )
85	            try record(detailReadySample)
86	            sampleIndex += 1
87	            waitUntilNextSample(startedAt: detailReadySampleStartedAt, sampleMS: config.sampleMS)
88	
89	            if config.foregroundCycleBeforeReady == true {
90	                XCUIDevice.shared.press(.home)
91	                RunLoop.current.run(until: Date().addingTimeInterval(0.75))
92	                try DisplayedUIArtifactWriter.markReady(to: config.readyPath)
93	                let delay = TimeInterval(config.foregroundResumeDelayMS ?? config.sampleMS) / 1000.0
94	                RunLoop.current.run(until: Date().addingTimeInterval(max(0.1, delay)))
95	                app.activate()
96	                XCTAssertNotNil(
97	                    app.displayedUIWaitForElement(identifierPrefix: AutomationID.Session.root(threadID: openThreadID).rawValue, timeout: 15),
98	                    "Displayed sync proof did not return to target thread detail after the foreground cycle for \(openThreadID)."
99	                )
100	            } else {
101	                try DisplayedUIArtifactWriter.markReady(to: config.readyPath)
102	            }
103	
104	            let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(TimeInterval(config.durationMS) / 1000.0)
105	            var didTapRequestAction = false
106	            var didCompleteFileChangeReview = false
107	            repeat {
108	                let sampleStartedAt = Date()
109	                let sample = captureSample(index: sampleIndex)
110	                try record(sample)
111	                sampleIndex += 1
112	                if !didTapRequestAction,
113	                   let action = config.requestAction,
114	                   let detail = sample.detail {
115	                    if let cardID = config.requestCardID,
116	                       detail.containsRequestCard(cardID: cardID) == true,
117	                       // Do not mutate a controlled request until the UI dump
118	                       // has proved the same relay projection row is visible.
119	                       detail.containsMessageCard(projectionID: cardID) == true,
120	                       app.tapRequestAction(cardID: cardID, action: action, timeout: 0.2) {
121	                        didTapRequestAction = true
122	                    } else if config.requestCardID == nil,
123	                              app.tapFirstRequestAction(
124	                        requestElementIdentifiers: detail.requestCardIDs,
125	                        action: action,
126	                        timeout: 0.2
127	                    ) {
128	                        didTapRequestAction = true
129	                    }
130	                }
131	                if !didCompleteFileChangeReview,
132	                   let eventID = config.fileChangeReviewEventID,
133	                   let fileID = config.fileChangeReviewFileID,
134	                   let requestCardID = config.fileChangeReviewRequestCardID,
135	                   let detail = sample.detail,
136	                   detail.containsMessageCard(projectionID: eventID) == true {
137	                    let requestPrefix = AutomationID.RequestCard.card(cardID: requestCardID).rawValue
138	                    let requestVisible = detail.requestCardIDs.contains { identifier in
139	                        identifier == requestPrefix || identifier.hasPrefix("\(requestPrefix).")
140	                    } || detail.requestStatus(cardID: requestCardID) != nil
141	                    if requestVisible,
142	                       app.completeFileChangeReviewFlow(
143	                        eventID: eventID,
144	                        fileID: fileID,
145	                        requestCardID: requestCardID,
146	                        timeout: 5
147	                       ) {
148	                        didCompleteFileChangeReview = true
149	                    }
150	                }

590	```sh
591	rtk make sim-ui-controlled-matrix-proof SIM='iPhone 17'
592	```
593	
594	The matrix mutates controlled Codex data, watches relay truth, samples the
595	literal simulator accessibility state over time, and fails when the UI does not
596	converge within the configured lag budget. Dock row identity and order are read
597	from the Dock root `rowValues=` automation payload, so missing structured Dock
598	state fails loud instead of being reconstructed from a visual scrape. Thread
599	Detail message order is checked from top-to-bottom accessibility frames in the
600	scenarios where ordering matters. The proof reports are schema-checked by
601	`rtk npm run contract:check`.
602	
603	The generated-project test target includes UI automation smoke tests. Those
604	tests use the accessibility tree as the primary proof: screens, controls, rows,
605	visible state banners, and visible error states expose stable
606	`codexdock.*` automation identifiers plus accessibility values where the state
607	matters. Screenshots are useful triage evidence, but they are not the selector
608	strategy for this workflow.
609	
610	By default the simulator and UI tests launch the app against the current
611	two-host relay list: `amir-m5.fairy-salmon.ts.net:4510` and
612	`home.fairy-salmon.ts.net:4510`. `CODEX_DOCK_HOSTS` is the complete host list
613	for that launch, so saved or discovered hosts do not change the test surface.
614	To use a different relay endpoint, pass a comma-separated host list:
615	
616	```sh
617	CODEX_DOCK_UI_TEST_HOSTS='Amir-M5.local:4510' rtk make app-test SIM='iPhone 17'
618	```
619	
620	Builds and installs are Makefile-owned. Do not use raw Xcode, CoreDevice,
621	simulator install, or Flutter build/install commands as the normal workflow;
622	add or fix a make target instead. Raw platform commands are for diagnosing a
623	failed make target.
624	
625	Do not use fixture or SwiftUI preview rows as production evidence. A physical
626	phone pass means the installed app connects to the real relay-backed host path,
627	renders real `DockThreadCard` rows, and shows offline/error UI when that same
628	host path is unavailable. While physical testing is deferred, the agent-side
629	stand-in is simulator plus local/real-relay/service-status proof, with the
630	physical checks recorded for Amir.

4	    static func resetSamples(at path: String) throws {
5	        let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
6	        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(

8	            withIntermediateDirectories: true,
9	            attributes: nil
10	        )
11	        try Data().write(to: url, options: .atomic)
12	    }
13	
14	    static func appendSample(_ sample: DisplayedUISample, to path: String) throws {
15	        let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
16	        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
17	            at: url.deletingLastPathComponent(),
18	            withIntermediateDirectories: true,
19	            attributes: nil
20	        )
21	        let data = Data((sample.jsonLine + "\n").utf8)
22	        if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: path) {
23	            try data.write(to: url, options: .atomic)

25	        }
26	        let handle = try FileHandle(forWritingTo: url)

28	            try? handle.close()
29	        }
30	        try handle.seekToEnd()
31	        try handle.write(contentsOf: data)
32	    }

36	            return

43	        )

### 7. **Existing Fingerprint/Equality/Change-Detection Usage**
**Search scope:** Entire repo grep for "fingerprint", "unchanged", "skip", "identical", "dedup", existing snapshot comparisons.

**FINDINGS:**

| Point | Finding |
|-------|---------|
| **Types Equatable?** | DockRenderSnapshot ✓, DockSnapshot ✓, DockRowViewModel ✓, DockCardProjection ✓, DockProjectionOptions ✓, RenderRevision ✓ — **All are Equatable.** |
| **Stable identity per row** | `projectionID` (== `id`), `threadIdentity` (hostID + threadID), `backendSessionID`. Can construct fingerprint from these 3 + status + isPinned + pinnedOrder. |
| **`project(options:)` cost** | **O(n log n)** with high constant — filtering (full-text search + multi-facet), sorting, grouping, facet uniquing. Called once per snapshot publish. |
| **Existing change-detection** | **NONE.** No snapshot comparison before publish. RenderCoalescer only checks revision ordering, not content equality. |
| **Per-host revision available** | YES — ThreadCardProjectionState tracks per-host revisions, but NOT used to short-circuit projection. |
| **Cheap identity surface** | YES — rows have stable identity (projectionID, threadIdentity, backendSessionID). Could fingerprint via these + status + pinning state. |

## Recommended Fingerprint Surface

For your "this publish does not change the rendered screen" detection:

1. **Row fingerprint:** Hash(projectionID + threadIdentity.hostID + threadIdentity.threadID + status + isPinned + pinnedOrder). This identifies rows that would render identically.

2. **Snapshot fingerprint:** Hash(rowCount + row_fingerprints_sorted + lens + isPartial). If this matches the previous snapshot's fingerprint, the projection will be identical regardless of options (search, filters) because the rows haven't changed.

3. **Projection fingerprint:** Hash(snapshot_fingerprint + projection.pinnedRows.count + projection.rows.count + projection.groups.count). This confirms the projection would be identical.

**Cost:** O(n) for row fingerprinting (one pass over rows), O(1) for snapshot/projection fingerprints. Much cheaper than O(n log n) projection.


**Per-host revision tracking:** Each `HostProjection` has a `revision: Int` field (line 8). This is compared on update (line 35): `guard snapshot.revision >= state.revision` to drop stale updates.

**Does it feed cheap change-detection?** **Potentially YES, but not currently used.** ThreadCardProjectionState tracks per-host revision numbers, which could be used to detect whether a new `renderInput()` would produce different data. However:
- `renderInput()` does NOT return a fingerprint or revision.
- DockScreenStore never checks if consecutive inputs would produce identical snapshots.
- The `revision` numbers track **card stream freshness**, not **rendered output changes**.

**Conclusion:** Per-host revisions exist but are NOT leveraged for render change-detection. The infrastructure is NOT there to cheaply detect "this renderInput won't change the projection."

---

## Summary: Key Findings for Architecture Fix

| Point | Finding |
|-------|---------|
| **Types Equatable?** | DockRenderSnapshot ✓, DockSnapshot ✓, DockRowViewModel ✓, DockCardProjection ✓, DockProjectionOptions ✓, RenderRevision ✓ — **All are Equatable.** |
| **Stable identity per row** | `projectionID` (== `id`), `threadIdentity` (hostID + threadID), `backendSessionID`. Can construct fingerprint from these 3 + status + isPinned + pinnedOrder. |
| **`project(options:)` cost** | **O(n log n)** with high constant — filtering (full-text search + multi-facet), sorting, grouping, facet uniquing. Called once per snapshot publish. |
| **Existing change-detection** | **NONE.** No snapshot comparison before publish. RenderCoalescer only checks revision ordering, not content equality. |
| **Per-host revision available** | YES — ThreadCardProjectionState tracks per-host revisions, but NOT used to short-circuit projection. |
| **Cheap identity surface** | YES — rows have stable identity (projectionID, threadIdentity, backendSessionID). Could fingerprint via these + status + pinning state. |

---

## Recommended Fingerprint Surface

For your "this publish does not change the rendered screen" detection:

1. **Row fingerprint:** Hash(projectionID + threadIdentity.hostID + threadIdentity.threadID + status + isPinned + pinnedOrder). This identifies rows that would render identically.

2. **Snapshot fingerprint:** Hash(rowCount + row_fingerprints_sorted + lens + isPartial). If this matches the previous snapshot's fingerprint, the projection will be identical regardless of options (search, filters) because the rows haven't changed.

3. **Projection fingerprint:** Hash(snapshot_fingerprint + projection.pinnedRows.count + projection.rows.count + projection.groups.count). This confirms the projection would be identical.

**Cost:** O(n) for row fingerprinting (one pass over rows), O(1) for snapshot/projection fingerprints. Much cheaper than O(n log n) projection.

## Findings Report: Dock UI Sync Proof Contract

### 1. Root-Value Parser: `dockRowsFromRootValue`

**File:** `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDockUITests/DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift:636-662`

**Function signature:**
```swift
private func dockRowsFromRootValue(_ rootValue: String) -> [DisplayedUIDockRow]?
```

**Parsing logic:**
- Extracts the `rowValues=` field from the root accessibility value using `codexDockAutomationField("rowValues", in: rootValue)` (line 637)
- Field parser uses semicolon (`;`) delimiters to split top-level fields (line 1033)
- Splits rowValues on pipe (`|`) to separate individual row payloads (line 643)
- Each row payload is URL percent-encoded and decoded with `removingPercentEncoding` (line 645)
- Row format: `identifier=value` where `identifier` must have prefix `codexdock.dock.row.` (line 652)
- Separator is first `=` character; everything after is the value (lines 646-651)
- Returns `[DisplayedUIDockRow]` with: `identifier`, `value`, `label: ""` (empty), and `frame` with `minY` set to enumeration index

**Example payload structure:**
```
rowValues=codexdock.dock.row.hostID.threadID=host%3DhostID%3Bsourcehost%3D....|codexdock.dock.row.hostID2.threadID2=...
```

---

### 2. All Callers of the Parser

**Direct callers of `dockRowsFromRootValue`:**

| Location | Purpose | Usage |
|----------|---------|-------|
| `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDockUITests/DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift:467` | `captureDisplayedUISample()` - normal sampling | Calls parser to populate `dockRows` field in `DisplayedUISample` |
| `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDockUITests/DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift:562` | `checkpointDockSweep()` - checkpoint proof | Calls parser and validates row count against expected |

**Dependent test files:**

1. **CodexDockDisplayedSyncProofTests.swift** (Primary sync proof)
   - Line 41-47: `captureDisplayedUISample()` called to snapshot visible Dock and Thread Detail
   - Records samples via `DisplayedUIArtifactWriter.appendSample()`
   - Tests relay-backed Dock convergence over time with controlled fixture mutations
   - Asserts samples reach "loaded" state (line 51)

2. **CodexDockLiveFilterProofTests.swift**
   - Uses `dockRows` from samples (indirectly via captureDisplayedUISample)
   - Tests Dock filter state changes

3. **CodexDockThreadRenameUITests.swift**
   - Captures `rootValueAfter` via per-row `.displayedUIStringValue` (line 225-249)
   - Does NOT use root `rowValues=` payload; uses individual row automation values

4. **CodexDockPerformanceScrollUITests.swift**
   - Likely uses samples for performance measurement

5. **CodexDockCurrentUIDumpTests.swift**
   - Dumps current visible state as JSON and Markdown

6. **CodexDockAutomationSmokeTests.swift**
   - Basic UI tree verification

7. **CodexDockUserMessageLatencyUITests.swift**
   - Samples Thread Detail state, not Dock rows

---

### 3. Per-Row Automation Value Encoding and Usage

**Per-row automation value definition:**

**File:** `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDock/Features/Dock/DockSharedViews.swift:290-303`

```swift
extension DockRowViewModel {
    var automationValue: String {
        [
            "host=\(hostID)",
            "sourceHost=\(sourceHostID ?? "none")",
            "projection=\(projectionID)",
            "hostDisplay=\(hostDisplayName)",
            "thread=\(threadID)",
            "status=\(status.rawValue)",
            "origin=\(origin.automationKind)",
            "relationship=\(relationship.rawValue)",
            "label=\(label == nil ? "none" : "present")",
            isPinned ? "Pinned" : "Not pinned",
        ].joined(separator: "; ")
    }
}
```

**Where the row automation value is used:**

1. **In Dock root accessibility value:**
   - `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDock/Features/Dock/DockView.swift:1094`
   - Each row's `automationValue` is percent-encoded and concatenated into `rowValues=` payload
   ```swift
   let identifier = AutomationID.Dock.row(hostID: row.hostID, threadID: row.threadID).rawValue
   return automationEncoded("\(identifier)=\(row.automationValue)")
   ```

2. **On individual row element:**
   - `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDock/Features/Dock/DockSharedViews.swift:217` (DockRowView)
   ```swift
   .accessibilityValue(row.automationValue)
   ```

**Per-row automation value testing path:**
- Tests read individual row values via per-row element lookup: `dockRowElement(id:)` function (DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift:798-813)
- Example: CodexDockThreadRenameUITests.swift captures `renamedRow?.displayedUIStringValue` (line 225)
- This reads the per-row accessibility value, NOT the root rowValues concatenation
- Tests do NOT rely on per-row values being embedded in root `rowValues=` payload for most assertions

---

### 4. Sync Proof Mechanism (End-to-End)

**Proof pipeline:**

1. **Test orchestration:** `CodexDockDisplayedSyncProofTests.testSamplesRelayBackedDockDisplayOverTime()`
   - Launched via Makefile target `sim-ui-sync-proof` (Makefile:496-499)
   - Samples visible Dock/Thread Detail state at regular intervals

2. **Sample capture:** `captureDisplayedUISample()` (DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift:454-502)
   - Captures Dock root accessibility value
   - Parses `rowValues=` via `dockRowsFromRootValue()` → `[DisplayedUIDockRow]`
   - Records timestamp (ISO8601), identifiers, values, frames
   - Captures Thread Detail if visible (separate contract)

3. **Artifact persistence:** `DisplayedUIArtifactWriter.appendSample()` (DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift)
   - Writes `DisplayedUISample` as JSON lines to `/tmp/codex-client/.../ui-samples.jsonl`
   - Each sample includes `dockRootValue`, `dockRowsCapturedAt`, `dockRows: [DisplayedUIDockRow]`

4. **Relay sync audit:** `scripts/dock-relay-sync-audit.mjs`
   - Samples relay projection state over same time window
   - Records relay-emitted row IDs, order, field values

5. **Proof comparison:** `scripts/dock-relay-simulator-ui-sync-proof.mjs`
   - Compares captured UI samples to relay audit
   - Verifies row identity, order, and state fields match within `MAX_UI_LAG_MS` budget
   - Line 596-601 of README: "Dock row identity and order are read from the Dock root `rowValues=` automation payload"

**Configuration flag:**
- **File:** `/tmp/codex-client/codex-dock-sim-ui-sync-config.json` (ephemeral, expires in 10 minutes)
- **Required for:** Test runs CodexDockDisplayedSyncProofTests
- **Not environment variable:** Test uses file-based config, not `CODEX_DOCK_UI_TESTING` env var
- **Makefile targets using it:**

  - `sim-ui-scenario-sync-proof` (line 501)
  - `sim-ui-isolated-scenario-sync-proof` (line 506)
  - `sim-ui-controlled-scenario-sync-proof` (line 509)
  - Matrix variants (line 518)

### 5. Documentation/README Claims About Proof Contract

**File:** `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/README.md:596-601`

```
Dock row identity and order are read from the Dock root `rowValues=` automation
payload, so missing structured Dock state fails loud instead of being
reconstructed from a visual scrape. Thread Detail message order is checked from
top-to-bottom accessibility frames in the scenarios where ordering matters. The
proof reports are schema-checked by `rtk npm run contract:check`.
```

**File:** `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/README.md:99`

```
The repeatable over-time sync proof is documented in
[docs/CODEX_DOCK_LIVE_UPDATE_ARCHITECTURE_AND_TESTING_REFERENCE_2026-06-01.md]
```

**Architectural documentation:**

**File:** `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/docs/DOCK_LIGHTNING_FAST_ARCHITECTURE_FIX_PLAN_2026-06-04.md:37-44` (Owner paths)

```
- `CodexDock/Features/Dock/DockView.swift`
- `CodexDock/Dock/DockScreenStore.swift`
- `CodexDock/Dock/DockRenderProjector.swift`
- `CodexDock/State/DockStore.swift`
- `CodexDock/State/DockCardProjection.swift`
- `CodexDockUITests/DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift`
- `README.md`
```

---

### 6. AutomationID.Dock: Row-Related Identifiers

**File:** `/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDock/Automation/AutomationID.swift:165-260`

**Row-related identifiers:**

| Identifier | Factory Function | Usage |
|------------|-----------------|-------|
| Root Dock container | `Dock.root` | "codexdock.dock.root" - parent of all rows |
| Individual row | `Dock.row(hostID:threadID:)` | "codexdock.dock.row.{hostID}.{threadID}" - accessibility ID for row element |
| Row action | `Dock.rowAction(hostID:threadID:action:)` | "codexdock.dock.row.{hostID}.{threadID}.action.{pin/unpin/...}" - context menu actions |
| Row color action | `Dock.rowColorAction(hostID:threadID:rail:)` | "codexdock.dock.row.{hostID}.{threadID}.action.color.{railColor}" - color picker |
| Host group | `Dock.hostGroup(groupID:)` | "codexdock.dock.group.host.{groupID}" - Host lens grouping |
| Host toggle | `Dock.hostToggle(groupID:)` | "codexdock.dock.group.host.{groupID}.toggle" - collapse/expand |
| Branch group | `Dock.branchGroup(groupID:)` | "codexdock.dock.group.branch.{groupID}" - Branch lens grouping |
| Branch toggle | `Dock.branchToggle(groupID:)` | "codexdock.dock.group.branch.{groupID}.toggle" |
| Host summary | `Dock.hostSummary(hostID:)` | "codexdock.dock.host.{hostID}" - host connectivity/status card |

**Key insight:** Individual row identifiers already exist and are stable (`codexdock.dock.row.{hostID}.{threadID}`). Per-row accessibility values are readable via per-element lookup, not just via root string concatenation.

---

## Strictness Assessment: Can Proof Migrate From Monolithic Root String?

**Current state (monolithic):**
- Single source of truth: `rowValues=` field in Dock root accessibility value
- Payload contains ALL visible rows' encoded automation values
- Separated by `|` delimiter
- Each entry: `identifier=percentEncodedValue`
- Parser: `dockRowsFromRootValue()` is the ONLY row identity oracle

**Migration viability:**

✅ **Per-row channel is viable** because:
1. Each row already has stable `codexdock.dock.row.{hostID}.{threadID}` identifier
2. Each row already exposes `automationValue` via per-element `.accessibilityValue()`
3. Tests already use per-row lookup: `dockRowElement(id:)` + `displayedUIStringValue` (used in rename tests)
4. Order can be reconstructed from visual frame positions or captured via separate list element (message list uses `projections=` field approach)

❌ **Loss of strictness if not careful:**
1. Parser has built-in validation: `identifier.hasPrefix("codexdock.dock.row.")` ensures only rows parsed
2. Parser uses `removingPercentEncoding` to normalize malformed input
3. Root concatenation makes "all rows present" synchronous with Dock render—removing it requires separate "expected row count" field
4. Order is encoded by enumeration index in frame.minY; per-element approach needs explicit ordering witness

**Recommendation for fix:**
- **Immediate:** Keep root `rowValues=` but compute it off-main-thread, cache result, only update on actual visible-set changes
- **Long-term:** Replace with out-of-band channel (e.g., Dock automation snapshot service) that does NOT live in SwiftUI body evaluation

---

## Performance Impact Summary

**Current lag source** (DockView.swift:1078-1105):
- Builds 469KB payload in 20-22ms for 1,247 rows
- Encoding: `automationEncoded()` applies percent-encoding to each row's full automation value
- Runs every time SwiftUI evaluates DockView body (on any publication)
- Heartbeat updates trigger full Dock publish → full root payload rebuild

**Data structure per row in payload:**
```
host=X;sourceHost=Y;projection=Z;hostDisplay=N;thread=T;status=S;origin=O;relationship=R;label=L;Pinned|
```
(Average ~350-400 chars per row after encoding)

---

This completes the precise, thorough map of the Dock UI/sync proof contract with exact file:line citations and payload format details.

## Strictness Assessment: Can Proof Migrate From Monolithic Root String?

**Current state (monolithic):**
- Single source of truth: `rowValues=` field in Dock root accessibility value
- Payload contains ALL visible rows' encoded automation values
- Separated by `|` delimiter
- Each entry: `identifier=percentEncodedValue`
- Parser: `dockRowsFromRootValue()` is the ONLY row identity oracle

**Migration viability:**

✅ **Per-row channel is viable** because:
1. Each row already has stable `codexdock.dock.row.{hostID}.{threadID}` identifier
2. Each row already exposes `automationValue` via per-element `.accessibilityValue()`
3. Tests already use per-row lookup: `dockRowElement(id:)` + `displayedUIStringValue` (used in rename tests)
4. Order can be reconstructed from visual frame positions or captured via separate list element (message list uses `projections=` field approach)

❌ **Loss of strictness if not careful:**
1. Parser has built-in validation: `identifier.hasPrefix("codexdock.dock.row.")` ensures only rows parsed
2. Parser uses `removingPercentEncoding` to normalize malformed input
3. Root concatenation makes "all rows present" synchronous with Dock render—removing it requires separate "expected row count" field
4. Order is encoded by enumeration index in frame.minY; per-element approach needs explicit ordering witness

**Recommendation for fix:**
- **Immediate:** Keep root `rowValues=` but compute it off-main-thread, cache result, only update on actual visible-set changes
- **Long-term:** Replace with out-of-band channel (e.g., Dock automation snapshot service) that does NOT live in SwiftUI body evaluation

---

**Current lag source** (DockView.swift:1078-1105):
- Builds 469KB payload in 20-22ms for 1,247 rows
- Encoding: `automationEncoded()` applies percent-encoding to each row's full automation value
- Runs every time SwiftUI evaluates DockView body (on any publication)
- Heartbeat updates trigger full Dock publish → full root payload rebuild

```

```

**Critical Finding — Heartbeat Handling (lines 276–284):**
```swift
private func applyHeartbeat(_ envelope: ProjectionEnvelope<Row>) throws {
    try validateOpenStream(envelope)
    guard envelope.seq == seq else {
        throw ProjectionReducerError.sequenceGap(expected: seq, actual: envelope.seq)
    }
    guard envelope.rows.isEmpty, envelope.projectionIDs.isEmpty else {

    }
}
```

**Architecture:**

```swift
mutating func apply(
    _ snapshot: StreamReconcilerSnapshot<DockThreadCardDTO>,
    host: DockHostConfiguration
) {
    var state = statesByHostID[host.id] ?? HostProjection()
    guard snapshot.revision >= state.revision else {
        return  // <-- Ignores older revisions
    }
    state.sourceHostID = snapshot.viewKey.sourceHostID ?? state.sourceHostID
    state.cards = snapshot.rows         // <-- Row data
```

- **streamHeartbeatTimeout: 15 seconds** (triggers offline if no envelope within 15s)
- **maxDockRowsPerMainPublish: 600** (batch limit for UI)
- **renderStreamBufferNewest: 1** (supersedes old revisions immediately)

- **No row-diffing logic.** A heartbeat with updated freshness but unchanged rows still triggers:

  2. DockStore.publishSnapshot() call
  3. Full DockRenderProjector.snapshot() recomputation
  4. ThreadCardRowProjector.rows() re-projection over all cards
- **Not structurally distinguishable** as "connectivity-only" — the gate cannot be placed at the projection layer without diffing row content at the reconciler level.

```swift
    updateProjectionMetadata(from: envelope)
    activeTurnID = envelope.activeTurnID

    lastError = lastError(after: freshness)
    scheduleHeartbeatIfNeeded()

    publish()
} catch {
    // ...

```

This prevents heartbeat-induced republishes from cascading to DockStore unless row content genuinely changed.

```swift
    updateProjectionMetadata(from: envelope)
    activeTurnID = envelope.activeTurnID
    freshness = freshnessState(after: envelope)
    lastError = lastError(after: freshness)

    let rowsChanged = (previousRows != reducer.sortedRows(policy: policy))
    if envelope.kind == .heartbeat && !rowsChanged {
        return  // Heartbeat with no row mutation — skip publish
    }
    
    publish()

    // ...
}
```

This prevents heartbeat-induced republishes from cascading to DockStore unless row content genuinely changed.
